Name: Short-Haired Bachelorettes
Author: PanTran
Description:
This portrait mod gives Penny, Haley, Emily, Leah, Maru, and Abigale some fresh new looks! 

Not much to say, it's pretty simple. Make sure you have BOTH Portraiture and Platonymous installed. Then simply put the folder into Portraitures "Portraits" folder.

I might make matching sprites, but I'm not sure. If anyone wants to do that themselves, though, go ahead! I'm not great at tiny pixel art lol
